coverage_approach: Broad queries include long-tail results (relevance=1) to maximize recall. Strict scoring at top ranks (relevance=3), generous in tail. Specific queries (CRM, LMS, M&E) have 6-9 results. Service provider queries have 5-8 results.
notes: Golden dataset with 26 queries covering the full spectrum of NGO/nonprofit technology ecosystem. Queries 1-3 are broad (15-24 results each), queries 4-18 are tool-focused (6-15 results each covering specific categories), queries 19-26 are service provider-focused (5-8 results each). Relevance based on user intent, sector alignment, and functional fit. Mixed categories allowed where query doesn't specify category.
